speaker: rep
text: Hi Sam, this is Dev from HyperSale. Thanks for taking the call. Is now still a good time?

speaker: buyer
text: I have about ten minutes. Go ahead.

speaker: rep
text: Great. Before I say anything about us, what made you look at sales coaching tools this quarter?

speaker: buyer
text: Our new reps take six months to ramp. Each one costs us a lot before they close a deal.

speaker: rep
text: Six months is long. What does that cost you per rep, roughly?

speaker: buyer
text: Somewhere around forty thousand dollars in salary before they pay for themselves.

speaker: rep
text: Got it. And who coaches them today?

speaker: buyer
text: Managers, when they have time. Which is almost never.

speaker: rep
text: So reps practise on real buyers. We give them voice role plays with an AI buyer, and every score quotes what they actually said.

speaker: buyer
text: That sounds nice, but your price is forty eight thousand a year. Why would I pay that?

speaker: rep
text: Fair question. If you cut ramp time by one month across ten reps, that alone covers it. Does that math match yours?

speaker: buyer
text: Maybe. I would need to see proof first.

speaker: rep
text: Reasonable. Can we run a two week pilot with three of your reps, then review the results together next Tuesday at ten?

speaker: buyer
text: Tuesday at ten works. Send me the invite.

speaker: rep
text: Will do. Thanks Sam, talk soon.
